features.label: Johor-Singapore Causeway

publishedLength.definition: Length of the Causeway structure from bank to bank, as published by the National Library Board; the National Heritage Board independently describes the completed causeway as 1,056 metres long.

geometry.note: Approximate display line only. Coordinates were not supplied by the cited length sources and have not been surveyed or independently verified.

sources.title: The Johor-Singapore Causeway
sources.supports: Describes the structure between Johor Bahru and Woodlands as the 1,056-metre-long causeway.

sources.title: The Making of the Causeway
sources.supports: Publishes the planned Causeway length as 3,465 feet (1,056 metres) from bank to bank and identifies the structure as the link between the two territories.

caveats: The 1,056 m value describes the Causeway structure from bank to bank; it is not a driving-route, approach-road, checkpoint or interchange distance.
The National Library Board passage states the proposed engineering length; the National Heritage Board separately applies the same length to the completed causeway.
The schematic endpoints are approximate and must not be used as surveyed endpoints or to recompute the published length.

features.label: Malaysia-Singapore Second Link

publishedLength.definition: Length of the bridge section crossing the Johor Strait, as published by the Malaysian highway operator PLUS Malaysia.

geometry.note: Approximate display line only. Coordinates were not supplied by the cited length source and have not been surveyed or independently verified.

sources.title: Our Expressways — Malaysia-Singapore Second Link (LINKEDUA)
sources.supports: States that the 47-kilometre LINKEDUA highway includes a 1.92 km-long bridge crossing the Straits of Johor, linking Tanjung Kupang to Tuas.

caveats: The 1,920 m value is the bridge section across the Johor Strait; the same source's 47 km figure is for the wider dual-three-lane LINKEDUA highway and must not be used as the crossing length.
The value is a published operator figure, not a length recalculated from the schematic line.
The schematic endpoints are approximate and must not be used as surveyed endpoints or to recompute the published length.
